t: Solving Key Paralysis: Auto-Incrementing Composite Keys in Action
s: A context-aware, auto-incrementing composite key system is implemented, combining profile, plugin, and sequential IDs to eliminate user 'key paralysis', enhance data organization, and improve system intuitiveness.
sub: Eliminating 'key paralysis' through intelligent defaults and pre-filling
